# CodeAtlas v0.1.0 — "First Light"

The first release of CodeAtlas: a complete vertical slice from `composer require` to an interactive architecture graph in the browser.

```
Source Code → Scanner → AST Parser → Analyzer → DTO → JSON → UI
```

Every stage of the pipeline ships, verified end to end.

## Highlights

**🔭 Analyze a Laravel app in one command**

```bash
composer require codeatlas/laravel
php artisan codeatlas:analyze
```

**🗺️ Route analyzer** — extracts every route via AST (never regex): all HTTP verbs, `any`/`match`, `resource` & `apiResource` expansion, closures, invokable controllers, fluent and array-style groups with arbitrary nesting, middleware accumulation, `where` constraints and shortcuts, URI parameters, name prefixes.

**📊 Interactive UI** — drop the JSON into the CodeAtlas web app: searchable type-grouped sidebar, React Flow graph canvas with per-type colors, and a typed inspector (URI, methods, controller, middleware, constraints, source file). Edge targets whose analyzers don't exist yet (controllers, middleware) render as placeholders derived from the node-ID convention — every relationship is visible from day one.

**🧱 Built as a platform** — analyzers and exporters are plugins on framework-free contracts. The Laravel bridge is the only package containing Laravel code; the core runs anywhere PHP 8.3 does.

**🛡️ Fault isolation** — a malformed file never aborts an analysis. It's logged, recorded as a warning in the output document, and the run continues.

## The numbers

- 6 PHP packages · 73 source files · 80 test files
- React + TypeScript (strict) UI · 26 component/unit tests
- 400+ runtime-verified assertions during development
- PHPStan level max · PER coding style · conventional commits

## Requirements

- PHP 8.3+ · Laravel 11+ (for the bridge)
- Any modern browser (for the UI)

## Installation

```bash
composer require codeatlas/laravel
php artisan codeatlas:analyze
php artisan vendor:publish --tag=codeatlas-config   # optional
```

## What's next (v0.2.0 — "Connections")

Middleware and controller analyzers — the placeholder nodes in your graph become real, with methods, dependencies, and traits. See [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/novaprime-code/codeatlas/blob/main/ROADMAP.md).

## Notes

- The JSON schema is versioned independently (`1.0.0`); the UI accepts any `1.x` document
- Full changelog: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/novaprime-code/codeatlas/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
